ui_bugs.issue: CRASH: tapping or clicking history-chart-touch throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading key)' (Expo error overlay, the app becomes unusable). RCA: on react-native-web, Pressable.onPress receives the DOM click event (node_modules/react-native-web/dist/modules/usePressEvents/PressResponder.js:302-314 onClick), so e.nativeEvent is a MouseEvent and has no locationX. locationX is undefined -> idx = NaN -> h.buckets[NaN].key throws. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/HistoryCard.tsx:101-105. Fix: const ne:any = e.nativeEvent; const x = ne.locationX ?? ne.offsetX; if (!chartW || !Number.isFinite(x)) return; and guard 'const b = h.buckets[idx]; if (!b) return;'. offsetX is relative to the Pressable because it has no children. Native should work, since it provides locationX.

With showEvery = 1 for 12w, the 12 absolutely positioned 40px labels ('KW34'...'KW45') sit about 26px apart at 375px and run together into 'KW34KW35KW36…', which is unreadable. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/HistoryCard.tsx:30,111-123. Fix: showEvery = 2 for 12w (or 3), or show only the week number '34'.

issues: staff-sheet-error stays visible after the user edits the username. Consider clearing the error on input change (minor).

The last two labels '2.' and '6.' have adjacent 40px boxes (about 4 days apart, because the last label is always forced). They are readable but tight; consider skipping the forced last label when it is fewer than 3 slots from the previous one.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the web crash in HistoryCard history-chart-touch onPress. Use nativeEvent.locationX ?? nativeEvent.offsetX and guard against NaN or an undefined bucket (HistoryCard.tsx:101-105).
MEDIUM: Thin out the 12w axis labels (showEvery 2 for 12w, or drop the 'KW' prefix) so they don't overlap at 375px.
LOW: Clear staff-sheet-error when the inputs change.
critical_code_review_comments: HistoryCard onPress reads e.nativeEvent.locationX with no fallback or NaN guard. Index-based array access then has no bounds or undefined check, so any bad coordinate is a hard crash rather than a no-op.

receipt.ts printHtmlWeb: if the iframe's onload never fires (readyState is not 'complete' and there is no load event after document.write), the frame is never removed. This is minor; it worked in Chromium (readyState complete path).

rca_of_issue: Chart crash: react-native-web PressResponder calls onPress(event) from the onClick handler with a React MouseEvent, and MouseEvent has no locationX. Math.floor(undefined / w * n) = NaN; Math.max(0, NaN) = NaN; buckets[NaN] = undefined; .key throws a TypeError and the Expo error overlay appears. Repro: log in as inhaber, open Tagesumsatz, tap anywhere on the chart. Mitigation: fall back to offsetX and guard against NaN.
